title: Rites of the Twin Keystone
summary: A rite-book of paired keystones that draw the force of a blow into the array and hold it until the maker lets it go.

title: The Hawk's Eye Array Treatise
summary: A treatise on arrays set high that see the whole ground at once and drop marks of force on what they find.

title: A Dual-Track Matrix Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of matrices run on two tracks at once so that the maker may pass through the pair as a single step.

title: The Canon of the Paired Heart Array
summary: A canon of healing arrays set in pairs that clear taint from the body and close the wounds of those within.

title: The Oath-Bearing Array Discipline
summary: A discipline of arrays held by oath and heading that step the maker along the wind without a closing form.

title: Plateau Wind Array Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of arrays that rise on the wind and draw its force in as a sail takes a gust.

title: The Unwalled Array Canon
summary: A canon of arrays with no closed edge that spread wide and let the maker move through them freely.

title: A Treatise on the Sworn Heading
summary: A treatise on arrays sworn to a heading that cleanse and mend the maker's company and hold the foe to the line.
